StageAttention: To fulfill its mission, Mannan M-1A bears the weight of the small island upon its back, hoping it will never crumble. Yet it does not know that its maker vanished long ago, and the nation that created it has long since fallen. It is a lone wanderer in the crimson abyss.
Mannan strikes in turn with its left and right claws, then charges the mechanical heart vent on its back, spraying a water jet to retreat backward and sweeping everything around it.
Mannan skitters sideways, jabbing at the target with its left claw, then crosses its body to launch a drilling strike with its spinning right claw.
Mannan charges the water jet on its back, then turns to sweep spray back and forth.
Mannan gathers energy in the battlefield into a sphere, then raises it high overhead and detonates it with its massive claws.
Mannan clamps down on the target ahead, and once it has the target restrained, fires a piercing shot through the heart.
Mannan shrieks ahead to drive the target back, then rips out its mechanical heart and swings it at the player three times. After the final blow, the mechanical heart compresses inward and explodes.
Mannan raises its mechanical heart and spins it to draw in the target, then advances while slamming down three times. After the final blow, the mechanical heart compresses inward and explodes.

Saturation Gauge is a resource shared by both the player and the Boss, with each side tracking its own gauge independently. Players can consume the gauge to perform a Threshold Dodge, empowering their next attack. The Boss consumes his gauge to unleash Overdrive Moves. During Overdrive, the Boss is immune to all damage. When the Saturation Gauge is depleted, the player or Boss enters Attrition. While in this state, the Saturation Gauge cannot be used again until it has fully recovered.
